catalysts.headline: Traded higher intraday alongside broad tech/chip sector rebound (carried over from prior research pass; no new corroborating source found this pass)

RBLX traded higher intraday alongside a broad tech/chip-stock rebound following the prior day's AI-sector selloff; Finviz showed $48.88 (+2.57% vs. the $47.65 Nov 5 close) as of ~2:50pm ET -- not a confirmed close.

Shares closed down 3.53% at $47.57; one outlet linked part of the move to a disclosed insider stock sale (~$757,974, per an SEC Form 4) amid unspecified 'broader market positioning'; the same day, Raymond James reportedly raised its price target to $51 (Buy)

Wedbush cut its Roblox price target to $52 from $55 and moved to Neutral, citing the Q3 2026 user-metrics/guidance miss; shares gapped down on the downgrade
catalysts.source: WebSearch aggregation (Defense World: 'Roblox (NYSE:RBLX) Shares Gap Down on Analyst Downgrade', dated 2026-11-01; MarketBeat RBLX news feed)

catalysts.headline: Shares gapped down from $52.46 (Oct 28 close) to as low as $43.31 premarket (-17.4%) after Roblox guided Q4 2026 bookings to decline 10-15% YoY and gave cautious initial 2026-cycle commentary
Q3 2026 results: revenue $1.57B (+16% YoY), net loss narrowed 11% YoY to $230M; nine-month revenue $4.48B (+29% YTD); DAUs 138M (+12% QoQ, -9% YoY)

Roblox reported Q3 2026 results after market close: GAAP EPS -$0.32 (beat consensus of roughly -$0.40 to -$0.43); revenue $1.57B (+16% YoY from $1.36B), reported as a slight miss vs. ~$1.62B consensus; bookings $1.697B, down 12% YoY from $1.922B but above the high end of the company's own -14% to -18% guidance; GAAP net loss $230M (narrower than $258M a year ago); adjusted EBITDA $138M; free cash flow $364M. Daily active user growth reportedly turned negative (~-9%) for the first time. Q4 bookings guidance calls for a 10-15% YoY decline. Shares fell roughly 17% after hours despite the EPS/bookings beat.

Delayed market reaction to 'Roblox Everywhere' platform announcements from the prior week's developer conference (cross-platform distribution, offline play, AI dev tools), amplified by a round of Wall Street price-target hikes (e.g., Wedbush)
Alongside Q2 2026 results, Roblox guided bookings down as much as 18% for the following quarter and withdrew its full-year bookings outlook
catalysts.impact: Significant negative guidance change layered on top of the Q2 EPS beat/revenue-miss print already on file
